en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a panoramic view over a forested mountainous valley with open meadows and a small village nestled in the center. The village has scattered houses, a church-like building, fields and a road running along the valley. Tall conifer trees frame the foreground. At the bottom of the image, printed white text reads "WILDENTHAL i. Erzgeb. 732 m".
